posts.text: God Bless our Secret Service agents and all of our brave law enforcement who are always ready to protect @realDonaldTrump, @VP, all elected officials, and the people attending the #WHCD. In times of crisis, we are all Americans. Let’s remember that.

Byron Donalds unveils the Insurer Scorecard during stop on the Defending the Florida Dream Tour

Video

Donna Fiala will be missed deeply by all of Collier County. Her leadership can be felt and seen all over Marco  Island, East Naples and elsewhere about the county. I never met a leader who truly had their finger on the pulse of their constituency quite like she did. Her initiatives were motivated by an unapologetic love for the community she played such a critical role in growing. There will never be another like her. The county, her constituents and our family mourn the loss of a legacy leader

Great time this morning in Pinellas County rolling out my Insurer Scorecard, my plan to boost transparency and lower insurance costs for Floridians. 

Florida families need relief from sky-high property insurance rates. You deserve to know what insurance costs and how well it performs before you buy. 

As Governor, I will fight to put you the consumer in control.

Had a great time with Sheriff Grady Judd, and Representatives Jennifer Canady and Hilary Holley at Reececliff Family Diner. 

Thank you to all the patriots who packed the house and brought the energy this morning. 

We can't wait to be back in Imperial Polk County!

It's important for the American people to understand just how radical the Democrats have become with the shutdown: 

The Democrat party left our borders WIDE OPEN letting in tens of millions of illegals into our country. 

They allowed drug cartels to make BILLIONS trafficking people into our country. 

The Democrat Shutdown is once again throwing our borders wide open to the cartels.

Polk County, the Defending the Florida Dream Tour is coming your way! Join us THIS FRIDAY, April 24, at Reececliff Family Diner in Lakeland with special guest Sheriff Grady Judd. 

Doors open at 10:00 AM, we'll see you there!

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/lakeland

Had an amazing time in Sarasota County at CoastLife Church! 

Thank you, Pastor Jason for your warm welcome and leadership.

It was an honor to share my faith and vision for the future of Florida with such a great community!
